cases.why: the odds argument is optional, so joining before load_playoff_odds() has run raises nothing at all -- every team silently gets None and the column ships full of dashes. This was the real bug in the first draft
the per-team odds ship twice -- once on the team objects the table sorts by and once in the meta block -- and the two copies can disagree after any change to only one of them
the rank is read off the ratings file's own ordering instead of the net rating, so any file that ever arrives unsorted numbers the league wrong while every row still looks plausible
two teams on an identical net rating can swap places between builds, so index.html churns with a ranking change nobody made and the diff hides real ones
the generator and the template disagree on the placeholder name, so the substitution never fires and the literal __PLAYOFF_META_JSON__ string ships to the reader
